hypotheses: sigma is a fixed B0 coarse source signature.
S_sigma is the survivor set of signature sigma; all vertices in S_sigma have the same exact 3-list L_sigma.
phi_sigma is any proper auxiliary 3-coloring of H_sigma=G[S_sigma] returned by the known P7-free List-3-Colouring algorithm.
R_i is one color class of phi_sigma and is therefore stable.
For every survivor v and every connected component C of residual G[Y0], the B0 theorem gives: v is complete or anticomplete to C.
I_{sigma,i} has bipartition (R_i, cc(G[Y0])) and edge vC iff v is complete to C.
conclusion: For every k>=1, every induced P_k in I_{sigma,i} lifts to an induced P_k in G by replacing each component-node C with an arbitrary representative c in C.
Consequently the existing P7-free bipartite chain-decomposition theorem applies to I_{sigma,i}.

proof_core: Consecutive survivor-component pairs remain edges because incidence means complete-to-component.
Nonconsecutive survivor-component pairs remain nonedges because B0 complete/anticomplete uniformity turns incidence nonedge into anticomplete-to-component.
Survivor-survivor chords are impossible inside stable R_i.
Component-component chords are impossible between distinct connected components of G[Y0].
These four pair classes exhaust all pairs on the lifted path.
firewalls: phi_sigma is an auxiliary stable-layer certificate only and is not a committed global extension coloring.
The theorem does not assert that the union of the three incidence layers is P7-free, chain-decomposable, or bounded-mim-width.
The theorem does not assert that three decomposition-tree positions determine a polynomial-size joint DP state.
The theorem does not solve survivor-relational structure globally.
The theorem does not close the nonedge Z-survivor compression gate.
The theorem does not prove the final L2 coverage repair.
The theorem does not prove Lemma 11 for P7-free graphs.
The theorem does not prove polynomial-time 4-Coloring for P7-free graphs.
